snippet.title: Unshine Arcade - Demo Trailer
snippet.description:
DEMO OUT NOW: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4178320/Unshine_Arcade_Demo/

Hey everyone,

The demo is OUT NOW! 

I’m extremely excited to announce this during Day of the Devs 2025 (Game Awards edition). It’s an honor to be a part of, alongside some amazing indies.
 
It’s an enormous milestone for my solo development debut and it’s crazy to see how far the game has come since I came up with this arcade roguelike idea one and a half years ago.  

The demo fully showcases the first arc of the game. Let me know what you think!

In the full game you can expect more arcade floors with some brand new machines, a way to discover the real reason behind the (S)Unshine Arcade's existence with the full story and of course... a lot more gachas. 
THANKS FOR PLAYING!

Go win some tickets and feed them to the egg right now. 
(Or spend it all in the claw machine your choice).

~ mardt

#mardt #indiegame #roguelite
